question: Where can I find a zoo that lie within 180 kilometers toward the northeast side of Oskaloosa Care Center, Oskaloosa, IA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'zoo' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Oskaloosa Care Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Oskaloosa%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IA%' LIMIT 1 ), 180000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Oskaloosa Care Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Oskaloosa%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IA%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
